name: Riverside
source:
Riverside is a short visual novel about about two men planning their future together. Choose how you would like to grow old with somebody you love and simply enjoy your date on the river.

[From [url=https://arthurrothe.itch.io/riverside]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《河滨》是一部简短的视觉小说，讲述了两个男人共同规划未来的故事。选择你想如何与你所爱的人白头偕老，然后享受河边的约会。

[来自[url=https://arthurrothe.itch.io/riverside]itch.io[/url]]
